fourth-lateran-council.research_focus: the Fourth Lateran Council of 1215 in Rome, the Lateran basilica, medieval bishops in mitres and copes
fourth-lateran-council.scene: Inside a vast stone basilica nave, rows of mitred bishops in heavy copes sit facing each other on long benches, a scribe at a lectern recording while a pope presides from a raised throne

celestine-v-resigns.research_focus: Celestine V, the hermit pope, resigning in Naples at the Castel Nuovo in 1294, a rough monk's habit beside papal robes
celestine-v-resigns.scene: In a plain stone chamber, a frail elderly hermit in a patched monk's habit lays a tall papal tiara on a table before a cluster of cardinals, a wooden staff leaning against his shoulder

council-constance-ends-schism.research_focus: the Council of Constance, 1414-1418, held in the cathedral of Konstanz on Lake Constance, election of Martin V
council-constance-ends-schism.scene: In a lakeside cathedral, cardinals and robed churchmen crowd around a single robed figure being lifted into a throne, banners of several nations hanging overhead

alexander-vi-elected-pope.research_focus: the 1492 conclave that elected Rodrigo Borgia as Alexander VI, the Sistine-era Vatican, cardinals' ballot cups, Renaissance papal robes
alexander-vi-elected-pope.scene: In a candlelit Renaissance chamber, a stout cardinal in robes receives a heavy papal cope from kneeling attendants while other cardinals look on, a small chest of coins half-hidden behind a curtain

clement-xiv-suppresses-jesuits.research_focus: Pope Clement XIV signing the 1773 brief Dominus ac Redemptor suppressing the Society of Jesus, eighteenth-century Quirinal Palace, black Jesuit cassocks
clement-xiv-suppresses-jesuits.scene: At a heavy desk in a baroque palace room, an elderly pope in a plain cassock signs a long sealed document while a line of priests in long cassocks stand with bowed heads at the far side of the room

pius-ix-elected-pope.research_focus: the 1846 conclave at the Quirinal Palace in Rome that elected Giovanni Maria Mastai-Ferretti as Pius IX, nineteenth-century cardinals
pius-ix-elected-pope.scene: From a palace loggia a newly elected pope raises a hand in blessing toward a crowd of hats, shawls and waving handkerchiefs filling a Roman square below

papal-infallibility-declared.research_focus: the First Vatican Council in St Peter's Basilica, 1870, bishops in the transept seating and the vote on the dogma of papal infallibility
papal-infallibility-declared.scene: Inside the great basilica, hundreds of bishops in tiered seating stand and raise their hands as a pope on a distant throne listens, a storm darkening the high windows

benedict-xvi-elected-pope.research_focus: the 2005 conclave: the Sistine Chapel chimney and white smoke over St Peter's Square, crowd below. No people's likenesses.
benedict-xvi-elected-pope.scene: A narrow chimney pipe on the roof of a chapel releases a thick plume of pale smoke into a dusk sky above a huge square, the crowd below only a sea of raised umbrellas and flags

francis-elected-first-latin-american-pop.research_focus: the 2013 conclave: the central balcony of St Peter's Basilica draped in a red banner, the square filled with a rain-soaked crowd. No likenesses; an empty balcony.
francis-elected-first-latin-american-pop.scene: An empty stone balcony with a heavy banner draped over its rail and a lit doorway behind it, a rain-wet square packed with a crowd holding flags from many countries

leo-xiv-elected-first-american-pope.research_focus: the 2025 conclave: the Sistine Chapel chimney with white smoke, St Peter's dome, and a crowd with American and Peruvian flags. No likenesses.
leo-xiv-elected-first-american-pope.scene: Pale smoke rises from a small chimney above a chapel roof beside the great dome of a basilica, below it a crowd waving flags, among them a few striped-and-starred ones
